fallback: I can only answer a few scripted questions in this demo: catching you up on a project, which projects are at risk, what changed this week, adding a launch checklist to a project, and how to list projects with the API. Try one of those below.

api.intro: Create a read-only key under [Settings › API keys](/app/demo/settings/api-keys), then send it as a bearer token. The endpoint returns every project with its status, owner, due date and task counts.
api.outro: Keys are shown once when you create them. This demo's API is illustrative, so the address does not respond.

failure: The assistant stopped responding before it finished.

status.intro: Here is a draft status update for **{project}**, written from this week's activity and its task list. Copy it, download it, or post it to the project as a comment.

agent.name: Tandem Assistant
agent.description: Answers questions about this workspace from its projects, tasks and activity.
agent.instructions: Answer from the workspace's records and cite the ones you use. State the rule behind any judgement, such as what counts as at risk. Ask which project is meant when it isn't clear. Never change records without the person's approval.
agent.output: Markdown with numbered citations; sources follow each answer.
